title: ModelerSymbol
description: One symbol element of a Portunix Modeler symbol pack (ptx-modeler, portunix-plugins #124), inspired by KiCad symbols and QElectroTech .elmt elements: metadata, an embedded SVG fragment, connection points, text field positions and standard compliance (e.g. IEC 60617). Files use the '.msym.json' filename suffix and live at symbols/<key with dots as slashes>.msym.json inside a pack. The file is self-contained, so a viewer needs no other file. Coordinates are paper millimetres with the y axis pointing down.

format.description: Element format identifier; readers reject unknown major versions

key.description: Key within the pack, e.g. 'socket.single'; must match the file path (symbols/socket/single.msym.json). The full key used in models is '<pack namespace>.<key>'

uuid.description: Stable identity of the element (lower-case RFC 4122 form); unique within a pack

names.description: Localized names keyed by language code; 'en' is required

category.description: Symbol category: socket, light, control, sensor, security, ...

placement.description: How the symbol is anchored in the model: single insertion point, polyline of arbitrary length, physical outline, or qualifier of another symbol

terminals.description: Connection points (optional in v1, prepared for wiring diagrams); ids are unique

texts.description: Text field positions (optional); the 'label' field positions the device designation

mount.description: Default mounting height above the finished floor in mm

aliases.description: Legend texts recognised by importers (compared case, spacing and diacritics insensitive)

meta.description: Free metadata such as author, license and source

standard.description: Relation of the symbol to a drawing standard

compliance.description: compliant = drawn exactly per the referenced standard symbol; derived = based on a standard symbol, adapted; custom = no standard symbol exists; vendor = manufacturer symbol

symbol.description: Symbol identifier within the standard, e.g. 'S00xxx'

edition.description: Edition, e.g. 'DB' for the IEC 60617 database

viewBox.description: minX, minY, width, height in paper millimetres; width and height are positive

anchor.description: Insertion point in fragment coordinates; default [0, 0]. Terminals and texts use the same coordinates

color.description: Default drawing colour; the fragment paints with currentColor

svg.description: SVG fragment without the <svg> root. Safe subset only: path, line, polyline, polygon, rect, circle, ellipse, text, g, title; no script, no event attributes, no external references (href and url() only to '#...'), no DOCTYPE

orientation.description: Direction the connection leaves the symbol

field.description: Field name, e.g. 'label' for the device designation

size.description: Font size in paper millimetres; default 2
